source.title: Editor: Workflow Settings select placeholders are hardcoded English

labels.name: status:in-linear
labels.description: Issue or PR is now in Linear

source.body:
### Bug Description

Three selects in the Workflow Settings modal have hardcoded English placeholders:

- "Select Execution Order"
- "Select Workflow" (error workflow)
- "Select Timezone"

https://github.com/n8n-io/n8n/blob/ff975f1b9e2f960da96801ae8f6fad040123c514/packages/frontend/editor-ui/src/features/workflows/components/WorkflowSettings/WorkflowSettings.vue#L1027
https://github.com/n8n-io/n8n/blob/ff975f1b9e2f960da96801ae8f6fad040123c514/packages/frontend/editor-ui/src/features/workflows/components/WorkflowSettings/WorkflowSettings.vue#L1063
https://github.com/n8n-io/n8n/blob/ff975f1b9e2f960da96801ae8f6fad040123c514/packages/frontend/editor-ui/src/features/workflows/components/WorkflowSettings/WorkflowSettings.vue#L1223

The labels and help texts next to these selects use i18n. The credential resolver select in the same modal already uses a key for its placeholder (`workflowSettings.credentialResolver.placeholder`).

### To Reproduce

1. Switch the instance UI to a language other than English.
2. Open a workflow and open **Settings** from the workflow menu.
3. While the modal loads, the Error Workflow and Timezone selects show "Select Workflow" and "Select Timezone" in English. Throttling the network in dev tools makes this easier to see.

### Expected behavior

The placeholders use i18n keys and show in the active language.

### Debug Info

Found by reading the source on `master` (version `2.44.0`). The strings are hardcoded in the component, so this does not depend on the instance setup.

### Environment

- Operating System: macOS (platform independent)
- n8n Version: 2.44.0 (`master`)
- Node.js Version: 24.x
- Database: n/a
- Execution mode: n/a

### Note

I have a PR ready for this.
